name: Napa Cabbage, Pork & Bell Pepper Stir Fry

instructions.primary_message: In a small bowl, combine and whisk together water, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and cornstarch.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp water
6 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp rice vinegar
3 tsp toasted sesame oil
3 tsp cornstarch

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice the pork chops crosswise into strips; transfer to a medium bowl.
Pour ½ of the sauce over the pork; toss to coat and set aside.
Wash and dry the cutting board, knife, and fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium head napa cabbage
3 red bell peppers
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 ½ small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Quarter the cabbage lengthwise (into wedges) and cut out the core; chop crosswise into bite-sized pieces (about 2 ½-cm-wide). Transfer to a large bowl.
Cut the bell peppers into 4 wedges lengthwise, then remove and discard the seeds. Thinly slice into strips lengthwise and add to the bowl of cabbage.
Trim and discard the ends of the green onions; chop the onions into 6-mm pieces. Separate the white parts from the greens and transfer to two small bowls.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince or grate the ginger; add to the white parts of the green onions.
Peel and mince the garlic; add to the onions and ginger.
Add coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the pork strips in the skillet; cook until browned, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Once the pork has been transferred, add more coconut oil to the skillet.
Add the ginger, garlic, and white parts of green onions; cook until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the bell peppers and cabbage to the skillet. Cook, stirring regularly, until the vegetables are tender-crisp and lightly browned, 3 to 4 minutes.

Add the pork (along with any juices), remaining sauce, and ½ of the remaining green onions (save the rest for garnishing) to the skillet; stir to combine and cook until the sauce is slightly thickened, 1 to 2 minutes.
Divide the stir fry between bowls and sprinkle with the remaining green onions. Enjoy!
